purpose: Rollback record for the demote of the non-compliant de-a1-numbers-ordinals pool. demote:pool writes NO rollback artifact of its own; this file is the only record of which rows were demoted and what their prior state was.
commands: pnpm --filter @language-drill/db demote:pool --language DE --cefr A1 --type cloze --grammar-point de-a1-numbers-ordinals --reason pool-hygiene --apply
pnpm --filter @language-drill/db demote:pool --language DE --cefr A1 --type translation --grammar-point de-a1-numbers-ordinals --reason pool-hygiene --apply
rollback: UPDATE exercises SET review_status='auto-approved', demotion_reason=NULL WHERE id IN (<ids below>);
rationale: digit-form non-compliance: 1 of 17 approved cloze rows carries a digit cue; 0 of 5 translations put the ordinal in digits in the English source ('Today is the third of May.'), which the directive requires.
Distributional collapse: 13 of 17 cloze rows use the frame 'Heute ist der ___ [month]', and 11 of 17 answer 'erste'.
Gloss spoilage: 8 cloze rows carry a glossEn, most naming the ordinal outright ('Today is the first of January.' -> erste).
pool-hygiene leaves learner mastery untouched; these are stale relative to a directive, not defective enough to revoke credit.
